fullName.value: Carboxy-terminal domain RNA polymerase II polypeptide A small phosphatase 1

texts.value: Preferentially catalyzes the dephosphorylation of 'Ser-5' within the tandem 7 residue repeats in the C-terminal domain (CTD) of the largest RNA polymerase II subunit POLR2A. Negatively regulates RNA polymerase II transcription, possibly by controlling the transition from initiation/capping to processive transcript elongation. Recruited by REST to neuronal genes that contain RE-1 elements, leading to neuronal gene silencing in non-neuronal cells
Stimulated by GTF2F1. Inhibited by beryllofluoride anions
Monomer (By similarity). Interacts with GTF2F1. Interacts with REST
Expression is restricted to non-neuronal tissues. Highest expression in skeletal muscle, spleen, lung and placenta
